pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ly is a lightweight TUI display manager. It runs on a plain VT, so it needs no X server of its own, and it launches both X11 and Wayland sessions from /usr/share/xsessions and /usr/share/wayland-sessions. This build is keyworded for arm64 and is built with dev-lang/zig-bin rather than a source Zig, which would require an LLVM bootstrap.

use.flag: Support launching X11 sessions, which links Ly against libxcb and pulls in the X server and the xauth/xrdb/xmessage helpers Ly calls when starting one. Wayland sessions work either way.
